_approach: Neurofunk micro-edit stutter: the kick/snare skeleton stays as dry and mechanical as the neuro_engine groove, but bar 2 ramps tension through increasingly dense 32nd-note snare/hat stutter-edits rather than a simple roll, then cuts completely silent for the last four 32nds - the 'glitch-cut' before the drop that Noisia/Mefjus-style engineering favours over a conventional build. Ref: Loopmasters' neurofunk breakdown/build tutorial (working backwards from the drop, drum fill leading directly in); Sample Focus's guide to neuro's edit-driven tension.
